item.title: Version 1.0.19
item.description:
backend: user_events log + /admin endpoints for friend-rollout monitoring

- New `user_events` table (JSONB metadata) self-healed in _ensure_schema
- `app/services/events.py`: best-effort log_event helper (never raises)
- `app/routers/admin.py`: /admin/{events,users,summary,sessions/recent}
  gated by X-Admin-Key for live triage during friend test
- Wired log_event into license.request_key, license.redeem,
  sessions.start, sessions._end_session_with_mdm_remove,
  sessions.emergency_end, mdm.ack/error
